Hi Maya,

Proposed slots:
- Tue Dec 9, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Dec 10, 13:00–14:30 PT

Attached are an updated SOW (v2) and a pricing summary so procurement has something to review ahead of the meeting. If either slot conflicts with your procurement sprint or the CFO window, we can shift — please advise what would be best for your timeline.

Agenda (90m):
1) 20m — architecture overview and latency/cost tradeoffs
2) 25m — demo + live prompts (Dev)
3) 20m — integration checklist and security notes
4) 25m — Q&A and next steps (PO/Procurement ask list)

If there’s pressure from finance to freeze spend ahead of the FY reforecast, happy to offer a shorter 30m exec briefing on one of the original slots to keep momentum while procurement completes its sprint.

Thanks —

Appreciate the materials. Quick heads-up: our procurement team kicks into a two-week sprint starting Dec 8 to validate vendor terms, and our CFO is traveling for the week of Dec 15–19 for the year-end reforecast. Finance has already signaled a short spend hold for anything not on the critical list until the reforecast is digested.

Because of that, we won’t be able to do a full technical deep-dive until after the reforecast (suggest Jan 6–10). That said, we do want to keep momentum — would you be able to do a 30m executive summary on Dec 10 at 10:00 PT (high-level architecture, expected TCO delta, and a quick list of integration ask items) so the GTM and procurement leads have something concise to review?

Also: can you mark the SOW as "for internal review only" for now and remove any hard dates until we lock the Jan window? Procurement is copied on this note.
